content.text: In regions where conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/solutions-when-stripe-paypal-ban-account-what-actually-2|COREMERCH guide to solutions]]-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-minimum-viable-stack-2|Payment Solutions]] platforms like Stripe and PayPal are restricted or non-existent, establishing a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-explained-digital-creators-4|digital]] store can feel impossible. This guide addresses that challenge head-on, specifically focusing on deploying your digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, utilizing the infrastructure provided by COREMERCH. You can accept crypto payments seamlessly and take control over your digital products without relying on unsanctioned platforms.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH infrastructure is purpose-built for digital creators in regions facing payment restrictions. Unlike traditional platforms that require dependency, this architecture is sovereign, giving you full ownership of your store. With tools like Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, you bypass barriers imposed by conventional payment processors. This infrastructure is not just a workaround; it’s a robust foundation designed to withstand financial isolation.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store using Stack 02, ensure you have a Cloudflare account and a GitHub account ready. Familiarize yourself with the Cloudflare dashboard and GitHub repository management. You will also need a collection of digital products to sell, such as ebooks, courses, or software. Having your payment method set up with NOWPayments is essential; this ensures you can receive payments in over 300 cryptocurrencies. Prepare your assets and documents for a smooth deployment process.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Begin by configuring your Cloudflare Pages environment. Set up your repository and upload your digital product files. Next, integrate NOWPayments by following the integration guide from COREMERCH. This involves connecting your payment gateway to your product listings, ensuring that transactions are processed automatically when customers make purchases. Use Supabase or Google Sheets for effective order storage and management. This setup will enable you to deliver products instantly upon payment confirmation.
Own your digital store infrastructure completely.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your store is set up, it’s time to go live. Verify all configurations and run tests to ensure everything functions correctly. Once you’re ready, promote your store using social media and direct traffic to your hosted URL. When a customer makes a purchase, the NOWPayments system will automatically handle the crypto transaction, and your digital products will be delivered seamlessly. Monitor the process closely during your first few transactions to ensure a smooth experience.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After your store is live and operating, consider scaling your offerings. You can add more products and explore different marketing strategies to increase visibility. Utilize the insights gained from customer interactions to refine your product offerings. If you're looking for a more advanced setup, consider upgrading to the Edge Commerce Stack, which provides enhanced features and support. This proactive approach will ensure your digital store remains competitive and efficient.

The difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 is not which one works — both work — it is which one fits your situation. Stack 01 is the right choice if you want to deploy yourself, you are comfortable with Google Workspace tools, and your initial volume is under 100 orders per day. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete Stack 01 build with full source code and step-by-step configuration. Stack 02 is the right choice if you want the deployment done for you, you need higher volume capacity, or you want email deliverability infrastructure configured from day one. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy Stack 02 under your accounts in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.

The setup decision comes down to time versus depth. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything to build Stack 01 yourself in an afternoon or Stack 02 over a weekend — full source code, step-by-step configuration, and the NOWPayments integration guide. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH build Stack 02 for you in 48 hours, end-to-end tested before handoff, with SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configured for email deliverability. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. Both are at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Read the Sovereign Blueprint before you start configuring anything — understanding the complete architecture before touching any settings prevents the most common configuration mistakes. Create all required accounts first: NOWPayments, Cloudflare or GitHub, Supabase or Google account, Resend or Gmail. Then configure the backend with all credentials before deploying it. Then deploy the backend and confirm the endpoint is live. Then configure NOWPayments with the endpoint URL. Then build and deploy the storefront. Then configure your custom domain if using one. Then run the mainnet test. Then check the order database. Then — and only then — share the URL. The sequence is not arbitrary. Each step depends on the previous one.
Frequently Asked Questions

You can build a digital store on Cloudflare Pages using a combination of free tools like NOWPayments for payment processing and a storage solution for your products. This setup allows you to create a fully functional store without the need for conventional payment platforms.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 utilizes GitHub Pages and Apps Script, deployed in 4-6 hours, while Stack 02, which uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with end-to-end testing before handoff.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are excellent hosting solutions for a digital product store. They provide the necessary infrastructure to host your products and manage payments efficiently without reliance on traditional payment platforms.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you flexibility in accepting payments from various digital currencies. This broad support enables you to cater to a diverse customer base.
What support is available after deployment?
With COREMERCH's Stack 02, you receive 30-day support following deployment. This ensures you have assistance as you navigate the initial challenges of running your digital store.
